segments.text: Kul Devta, Pitrs, and the Astral Hierarchy
Introduction: Time, Destiny, and the Astral Support System (0:00 - 8:00)

Greetings to everyone. Let us begin with a fundamental truth: never lose your real identity or true self. No matter how many layers life puts on you, you must not forget who you actually are. Leave your tensions and worries to the Divine force that brought you here and runs this universe.

People often complain that life is short or that their time has passed. But destiny operates on its own timeline. I have seen a man become a millionaire at 55 and someone get married at 26. When your time comes, divine grace aligns everything perfectly int o your equation. However, you cannot navigate life's bitter realities alone. You need the support of the astral world. An astral force or deity can guard you 24/7, calculate possibilities you cannot see, and protect you in dimensions your physical body can not reach. Your personal efforts mean very little compared to the power of the astral force standing behind you.
The Supreme Authority of the Kul Devta (Family Deity) (8:00 - 32:00)

The most important force standing behind you is your Kul Devta (Family Deity). They are solely responsible for advancing your lineage. Only the Kul Devta has the ultimate authority over three things: your birth, your death, and your marriage/companionship. They determine what luxuries you will enjoy and what you will eat.

Many people suffer endlessly because they do not know who their Kul Devta is, or they ignore them to worship other popular deities. If you ignore your Kul Devta , no other deity in the universe will help you. Why? Because the astral world operates on strict respect and hierarchy. If you go to a powerful temple (like Krishna or Shiva) to ask for help, that deity will look at the astral force standing behind you. If they see you have abandoned your own "father" (your Kul Devta ), they will refuse to bless you, knowing that someone who disrespects their own roots cannot be a true devotee. Therefore, your prayers elsewhere will hit a ceiling until your Kul Devta is honored.
The Pitr Trap: How Ancestors Hijack the House (32:00 - 50:00)

When a family forgets their Kul Devta , the deceased ancestors (Pitrs / Prets ) step in and hijack the house. Because they are your blood, they have a default claim over you. Once they take over, they act as the absolute kings of the household.

Pitrs do not want you to discover your Kul Devta or awaken your Drishti (Divine Vision) because it threatens their power. If a wise spiritual guide tells you to worship a specific deity, the divine messengers (Doots ) of that deity will try to enter your home to bless you. However, divine messengers are "gentlemen." They follow astral laws. Because the Pitrs hold the default authority over the house, the Pitrs will simply deny the messengers entry. The messengers will turn around and leave.

Furthermore, if you somehow discover who your Kul Devta is and start chanting their mantra, the Pitrs will simply intercept and consume that chanting themselves, never letting it reach the Kul Devta . They keep you trapped in an endless loop of suffering and blocked blessings.
The Solution: The Guru Protocol and Changing the "Default System" (50:00 - 1:07:20)
How do you bypass the Pitrs and reach your Kul Devta ? You cannot do it alone. You need a Guru. Specifically, Lord Hanuman.

Instead of praying directly to the Kul Devta (where the Pitrs will steal the prayer), you offer 100% of your chanting (Japa ) to your Guru, Lord Hanuman. The Pitrs are terrified of Hanuman and cannot touch what belongs to Him. You then pray: "O Lord Hanuman, please deliver this prayer to my Kul Devta."

Because the Guru acts as the ultimate divine bridge, the prayer bypasses the ancestors and hits the Kul Devta directly. Once the Kul Devta realizes the Pitrs have been manipulating the family, the Kul Devta will manifest and ruthlessly clear the Pitrs out of the house.

Changing the Default System: By default, ancestors claim ownership of your physical body. You must actively pray to Lord Hanuman: "I surrender my body, mind, and soul entirely to You. Revoke all claims my ancestors have on my physical vessel." Once you do this, you change your body's "default system." However, the Pitrs may have already built "astral flats" inside your body over the years. To fully evict them and destroy those energetic flats, you must combine this prayer with continuous Mantra chanting and Havan (Fire Rituals). II. Comprehensive Knowledge Article: Astral Jurisdiction, Kul Devtas, and the Ancestral Hijack

The astral realm operates much like a structured government, complete with strict jurisdictions, hierarchies, and protocols. Understanding these mechanics is the difference between decades of fruitless spiritual struggle and rapid, miraculous manifestation s. Based on the deep astral mechanics taught at Aashayein, here is a detailed breakdown of the power dynamics between Family Deities (Kul Devtas ), Ancestors (Pitrs ), and the Guru. 1. The Jurisdiction of the Kul Devta (Family Deity)

In the astral hierarchy, your Kul Devta is the supreme CEO of your lineage. While supreme gods like Shiva or Vishnu manage universal functions, your Kul Devta handles the micro - management of your specific bloodline. They hold absolute, exclusive authority over three immutable aspects of human life:

1. Birth (Lineage): Only the Kul Devta can grant children and expand the bloodline. 2. Death (Lifespan): They protect the lifespan of the family members. 3. Marriage & Prosperity: They dictate companionship, compatibility, and the luxuries the family will enjoy.
The Law of Astral Respect: If a person ignores their Kul Devta to worship a different, perhaps more "popular" deity (e.g., exclusively worshipping Lord Krishna while ignoring a

regional family deity), the popular deity will reject their prayers. The astral world views abandoning one's Kul Devta as the ultimate sign of disrespect. Other deities will not bypass a Kul Devta's jurisdiction to bless you. 2. The Ancestral Hijack (The Pitr Trap)

When a family forgets their Kul Devta , a power vacuum is created. The deceased ancestors (Pitrs ), who reside in the Pret Yoni (spirit realm), step in and hijack the household. Because they share your blood, they have a "default" legal right to your home and body.
Once they become the "kings" of the house, they actively sabotage the family's spiritual growth to maintain their supply of energy and offerings:

• Intercepting Prayers: If the family starts chanting a mantra for a deity, the Pitrs intercept and consume the energy of that chanting before it ever reaches the heavens. • Blocking Divine Messengers (Doots ): If a family member visits a saint who sends a divine messenger to bless their home, the Pitrs will stop the messenger at the door. Because divine messengers are bound by cosmic law (acting as "gentlemen"), they will not forcefully enter a home where the blood -ancestors deny them entry. • Preventing Drishti: The Pitrs will actively prevent anyone in the family from awakening their Drishti (Divine Vision), knowing that if the family sees the truth, the Pitrs will be evicted. 3. The Guru Protocol (Bypassing the Blockade)

Because the Pitrs guard the energetic doors of the house, a human cannot reach their Kul Devta directly. The only force that can shatter this blockade is the Guru element — specifically, Lord Hanuman.
The Strategy:

1. Offer to the Guru: The practitioner must dedicate 100% of their spiritual chanting (Jap ) to Lord Hanuman. Pitrs cannot intercept or consume energy dedicated to Hanuman. 2. The Delivery: The practitioner then asks Lord Hanuman to act as the messenger: "Please deliver my devotion to my Kul Devta." 3. The Eviction: The Guru bridges the gap. Once the Kul Devta receives the prayer and realizes the Pitrs have been starving the deity of worship and torturing the family, the Kul Devta manifests and violently evicts the Pitrs from the household. 4. Changing the Body's "Default System" (The Astral Real Estate)

By virtue of birth, your physical body's "default setting" grants your ancestors access to it. To stop ancestral manipulation, a practitioner must actively pray to Lord Hanuman to take absolute ownership of their body, mind, and soul, effectively overridin g the ancestors' legal claim.

The "Flat" Analogy: Even if you revoke their ownership, Pitrs may have spent years building "astral flats" (energetic blockages) inside your organs or chakras. To completely evict them, merely changing the default system is not enough. The practitioner must use Mantra Shakti and Havan (Fire Rituals) to burn down these astral flats, permanently clearing the body of ancestral influence. III.
